data.narrative:
Anthrogen is a Seed-stage biotech & health company founded by Ankit Singhal, Connor Lee, and Vignesh Karthik, having raised $4M to date. The sector peer universe comprises 3 public companies (RXRX, TEM, ONT.L) and 8 private firms including Colossal Biosciences, Chai Discovery, and Recursion Pharmaceuticals, though narrow same-stage comparables remain sparse.

Given data constraints, Stage-Progression methodology is the primary applicable lens. Using total capital raised ($4M) as a baseline value proxy and applying a standard Seed-to-Series A step-up multiplier of 2.5x yields an implied valuation of $10M. Peer-Median triangulation cannot be applied—while 7 same-sector peers exist, none satisfy minimum cohort density requirements (≥3) within adjacent stage or tier filters. Public-Comp Anchoring likewise cannot proceed absent revenue disclosure; though the Biotech & Health public median P/S stands at 7.4x across three tickers, Anthrogen's private revenue is not available.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $8M–$12M, centered on $10M. This range reflects Stage-Progression methodology only and carries material uncertainty. Key risks include: reliance on a single method, absence of tight peer comparables at Seed stage, and lack of revenue or operational milestones to calibrate multiples. Future re-valuation should incorporate revenue traction, clinical progress, or access to a denser set of recent Seed-stage biotech raises.
